findings.what: No link to /tentang-kami anywhere in the app (no nav/header); the About page is reachable only by typing the URL
No `test` script; `npm test` fails with 'Missing script: test' although node --test tests/*.mjs passes 14/14
Template metadata 'Create Next App' left in place and lang="en" on Indonesian content (a11y/SEO)
Kontak page has no navigation back to Beranda
Relies on node:sqlite (Node >=22.5) with no engines field; local file DB data/contact.db breaks on serverless/read-only hosts
Length limits count UTF-16 code units, not characters; non-BMP input is rejected before the real 100/2000 character limit
No test covers the server action or form value retention; only validation/store units are tested
